title: Engineering Report and Graph Generator — Overview and definition
t: Engineering Report and Graph Generator — Overview and definition
description: Turns datasets and analyses into publication-quality reports and plots.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Turns datasets and analyses into publication-quality reports and plots. An engineering report and graph generator binds datasets to plot templates and narrative sections, producing repeatable reports where every figure regenerates from data. Real implementations include matplotlib/seaborn pipelines, Plotly Dash reports, and LaTeX automation. It versions figures with the code that made them and flags stale graphics.

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Engineering Report and Graph Generator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Template plots: Bode, Smith, histograms, contour, 3D surfaces). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Template plots: Bode, Smith, histograms, contour, 3D surfaces and Data-bound figures that regenerate when data changes. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Technical document and specification generator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
